user.title: Sign in to Home Connect
user.description: How does this account sign in? An account with a password can be signed in to from here. One with a second factor or a passkey on it can only be signed in to in a browser.

menu_options.password: With an email address and password

password.title: Sign in with a password
password.description: Use the same address and password as the Home Connect app.

data_description.password: Sent to SingleKey ID to sign in, and never stored. Only the tokens it hands back are kept.

browser.title: Sign in in a browser
browser.description: Open [this address]({url}) and sign in with the account the app uses. The browser ends on a Home Connect page meant for a phone; ignore what it shows. Copy the whole address out of the address bar and paste it below.

data_description.code: The whole address, not just part of it. It is only good once and only here.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Home Connect again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored sign in has stopped working. Sign in again with the same account.

menu_options.reauth_password: With an email address and password

reauth_password.title: Sign in with a password
reauth_password.description: Use the same address and password as the Home Connect app.

data_description.password: Sent to SingleKey ID to sign in, and never stored. Only the tokens it hands back are kept.

reauth_browser.title: Sign in in a browser
reauth_browser.description: Open [this address]({url}) and sign in with the same account. Copy the whole address the browser ends on out of the address bar and paste it below.

data_description.code: The whole address, not just part of it. It is only good once and only here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Home Connect. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That sign in was not accepted. Check the address and password, and remember that a pasted address is only good once and only for a few minutes.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Another appliance has already asked. One sign in covers every appliance on the account.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different account. Sign in with the one this entry was set up for.
